advice.pause_and_confirm: Emisa phirimelano ena mme o netefatse boitsebiso ba moamoheli pele.

advice.trust_your_instincts: Ha ho bonala ho sa loke, emela. Bua le motho eo o mo tshephang pele o tswela pele.

demo.sample_scams.fake_job: Mahlohonolo! O khethilwe mosebetsi wa lapeng o lefang R5000/beke. Ho qala boemo ba hao, lefa tefiso ya ngodiso ya R500 ka EFT ho akhaonto 1234567. WhatsApp +27600000001 ho netefatsa.
demo.sample_scams.phishing: BANKA YA ABSA: Akhaonto ya hao e emisiwe. Netefatsa jwale ho www.absa-secure-login.co ho qoba ho valiwa ka ho sa phele.
demo.sample_scams.romance: Moratwi wa ka, ke kotsing e kgolo Dubai. Ba tshwere setshwantshiwa sa ka mme ba hloka $300 ho se lokolla. Ke tla u lefa habeli ke fihla. Hle nthuse, ke a u rata.
demo.sample_scams.advance_fee: Moamoheli o Ratehang, o khethilwe ho amohela $1.5 million ho tswa letlotleng la Dr. James Okafor. Ho lokolla matlole, o tlameha ho lefa tefiso ya tshebetso ya $200 pele.
demo.sample_scams.impersonation: TSEBISO YA SARS: O na le khokhelo ya lekgetho ya R3,200. E itjela ho www.sars-refund-portal.net kamora dihora tse 24 kapa e tla lahlwa.
